DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Auto-wired to the sibling 'postgres' service in this template. No need to edit.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password to access the admin dashboard at /admin. Auto-generated on deploy. Change it after first login.

CAP_ENDPOINT.description: Public URL of the sibling 'cap' CAPTCHA service. Auto-wired to this template's Cap service.

CAP_SECRET_KEY.description: Shared secret used to verify Cap challenge tokens (HMAC). Auto-generated; must match what Cap issues. Keep in sync with the Cap service if you rotate it.

CAP_SITE_KEY.description: Cap site key passed to the frontend widget. Leave empty unless you created a specific site key in the Cap dashboard.

CAPTCHA_MODE.description: CAPTCHA mode: 'auto' (use Cap if CAP_ENDPOINT is reachable, else none), 'cap' (force Cap), or 'none' (disabled).

FORM_RECIPIENT_EMAIL.description: Email address that receives form submissions. Set this to your address before going live — submissions are not delivered if it is empty.

SENDGRID_API_KEY.description: SendGrid API key for submission notifications. Leave empty to fall back to SMTP (see SMTP_HOST). Optional.

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname for sending notifications. Optional if SendGrid is configured.

SMTP_PORT.description: SMTP server port. Default 587 (STARTTLS). Use 465 for implicit TLS.

SMTP_USER.description: SMTP auth username. Optional for anonymous relays.

SMTP_PASS.description: SMTP auth password. Optional for anonymous relays.

FROM_EMAIL.description: From-address on outgoing notifications. Use a real address on a domain you control to avoid SPF/DKIM failures.

RATE_LIMIT.description: Max submissions per IP per minute. Default 10. Lower for stricter anti-abuse, raise for trusted internal use.

RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND.description: Rate-limit store: 'memory' (per-replica, fine for a single instance) or 'db' (shared via PostgreSQL; requires DATABASE_URL).

SESSION_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret used to sign admin session cookies. Auto-generated on deploy. Change to invalidate all active admin sessions.
